caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a rounded, metallic body that tapers into a square, tiered base. The body of the teapot is rendered in shades of gray and subtly accented with hints of blue, suggesting a reflective metal surface. The left side features a large, angular handle shaded in brown tones, likely representing wood, and the right side shows a curved spout with a textured pattern near its tip. The lid of the teapot is domed with a wavy, decorated edge and a small, knob-like handle at the top, matching the metallic color of the body. There is an elegant, looping monogram or design in the center of the teapot’s body, done in thin, gray lines. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, with a signature "M.A.R.S." and a small red star at the lower left of the teapot's base.
title: Silver Coffee Pot
